prompts.destinations: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production texture atlas image for the Lua game addon OddOrg, used as one GPU texture with 12 equal UV cells. Landscape aspect 4:3, exact edge-to-edge 4-column by 3-row grid of equal square cells. No gutters, no grid lines, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no labels, no watermarks. Every cell has the same solid very dark blue graphite #101822 background; each object sits centered with at least 15 percent empty margin from the cell edges so independent rectangular UV crops are safe. Premium semi-realistic hand-painted fantasy game inventory art, richly textured leather, aged brass, blue steel, subtle cyan reflected light and warm gold highlights, clean recognizable silhouettes readable at 48 to 96 pixels. Exactly the following cells, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom: row1 col1 a practical adventurer's brown leather BACKPACK with shoulder straps (Inventory), col2 a blue leather shoulder SATCHEL with long strap, col3 a tan tied cloth drawstring SACK, col4 a burgundy hard leather carrying CASE with brass corners and handle; row2 col1 squat dark iron SAFE with circular brass door, col2 upgraded tall blue-steel SAFE with twin gold locks, col3 weathered wooden STORAGE CHEST with crossed iron bands, col4 tall narrow green metal LOCKER with vent slats; row3 col1 elegant dark wood WARDROBE cabinet with two doors and brass handles, col2 a charming recognizable Final Fantasy style MOOGLE, small white furry round-bodied creature with little purple bat wings, red nose and red pom-pom antenna, holding a cyan crystal, col3 a substantial brass PADLOCK, col4 an engraved blue-steel SHIELD with a restrained cyan check mark symbol. Objects never cross cell boundaries. Consistent camera, lighting and scale. Each cell contains ONLY its assigned object. The atlas is artwork only, all names/counts/states will be overlaid as native readable text.
prompts.surfaces: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production material texture atlas for a premium fantasy game addon UI called OddOrg. Square canvas precisely split into 2 columns by 2 rows of equal square material swatches, edge-to-edge without gutters or visible gridlines. No objects, no text, no labels, no logos, no letters, no glyphs, no borders, no interface screenshot. Each quadrant is a clean close-up planar material whose appearance fills the quadrant. Palette very dark blue graphite, subdued teal-blue metal with extremely restrained warm brass flecks; values mainly between #101720 and #293747 so pale native UI labels stay legible. Top-left: fine matte graphite slate, soft granular tactile surface and very low contrast. Top-right: recessed-looking dark woven leather, understated fine grain, quiet center, suitable as an item-slot surface. Bottom-left: softly brushed dark blue steel, subtle horizontal machining grain and restrained satin sheen, suitable for buttons. Bottom-right: delicate dark teal etched metal with faint thin horizontal engraved filaments, suitable for small route accents and selection rail. Lighting flat, soft, controlled, no bright flare, no large gradients, no heavy vignettes, no focal object. Beautiful actual material texture, not flat vector colors. Each quadrant must remain usable cropped or stretched beneath text. One unified image asset, consumed through four fixed UV rectangles.
